mode.title: What to collect
mode.description: Search posts by keyword, posts of given accounts, account profiles, followers, following, or a post's reply thread.

queries.title: Search keywords
queries.description: Mode 'search'. Keywords, phrases, #hashtags, from:handle, mentions:handle, domain:example.com (Bluesky search syntax). One search per entry.

handles.title: Handles
handles.description: Modes 'authorFeed', 'profiles', 'followers', 'following'. Handles like bsky.app, profile URLs, or DIDs.

postUrls.title: Post URLs
postUrls.description: Mode 'thread'. bsky.app post URLs or at:// URIs.

maxItems.title: Max results per entry
maxItems.description: Maximum results collected for each keyword / handle / post URL. You are charged per result.

since.title: Since (search)
since.description: Mode 'search' only. Only posts after this date, e.g. 2026-01-31 or 2026-01-31T00:00:00Z.

until.title: Until (search)
until.description: Mode 'search' only. Only posts before this date.

language.title: Language (search)
language.description: Mode 'search' only. Two-letter code, e.g. en, de, ja.

includeReplies.title: Include replies (accounts' posts)
includeReplies.description: Mode 'authorFeed' only. Off = original posts, reposts and quotes only.

identifier.title: Bluesky handle (optional)
identifier.description: Optional. Login is NOT needed for normal runs. Provide with an app password only if public search is blocked for you.

appPassword.title: App password (optional)
appPassword.description: Create one at bsky.app > Settings > Privacy and security > App passwords. Never use your main password.
